summary_1line: Philosophical debate on rebirth, consciousness, and liberation, culminating in Panchasikha explaining body, senses, mind, and renunciation as the path to emancipation.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Panchasikha calmly instructs King Janadeva seated before him in a forest hermitage while other ascetics listen in silence.
A contemplative king sits troubled in a dim hall as the sage speaks about the body dissolving into the five elements—earth, water, fire, wind, and space.
Symbolic vision of a human body dissolving into the five elements while a luminous consciousness stands apart in stillness.
